output.assessment: Historical weather data from the India Meteorological Department (IMD) and local advisories establish that late August in Mumbai is characterized by active monsoon conditions, with high rainfall averages (561 mm monthly normal at Santacruz) and frequent gusty winds. While average wind speeds are mild at around 3 m/s (11 km/h), active monsoon spells regularly bring sudden gusty winds of 30–40 km/h and up to 50 km/h, alongside lightning risks. These conditions present severe safety hazards for outdoor rooftop stunts, including slippery surfaces, wind shear affecting motorcycle jumps, and lightning hazards for overhead metal trusses.

evidence.claim: According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD) climatological records, Mumbai receives an average of 561 mm of rainfall at the Santacruz station and 472 mm at the Colaba station during the month of August.
evidence.production_implication: The high likelihood of natural rainfall in late August means the rooftop surfaces will likely be wet, which will compound the wet conditions simulated by the SFX rain machines (req_sc_42_6) and increase the risk of hydroplaning or slipping for the stunt rider (req_sc_42_4).

evidence.claim: While average wind speeds in August are around 3 m/s (6 knots), the IMD frequently forecasts occasional gusty winds reaching speeds of 40–50 km/h during active monsoon periods.
evidence.production_implication: Gusty winds of 40–50 km/h pose a severe hazard to high-speed motorcycle jumps (req_sc_42_4) by destabilizing the rider mid-air and threatening the structural integrity of overhead truss systems and SFX rain machines (req_sc_42_6).

evidence.claim: IMD forecasts for the Mumbai region in late August include warnings for thunderstorms accompanied by lightning, light to moderate rainfall, and gusty winds of 30–40 km/h at isolated places.
evidence.production_implication: Rooftops are highly exposed to lightning strikes. A strict safety protocol must be in place to evacuate the crew and ground all electrical equipment, truss systems, and metal ramps (req_sc_42_1, req_sc_42_6) immediately if lightning is detected.

evidence.claim: August weather in Mumbai typically features a 70% to 75% chance of rain, high humidity (84%), and frequent overcast skies.
evidence.production_implication: Frequent overcast skies and sudden downpours make shooting during the limited 30-40 minute sunset window (req_sc_42_8) highly unpredictable, requiring flexible scheduling and backup shoot days.
